full_prompt_en: A square interior photograph shows a moody sitting room with charcoal paneled walls, a dark coffered ceiling and layered gray seating. Along the left wall, a long pale-gray sofa holds patterned cushions in cream, black and ochre. Above it, a large carved mirror reflects a small warm lamp, adding a second patch of amber light to the wall. A tall gridded window rises behind the sofa with a tan woven shade partly lowered. In the center foreground, a low dark wood coffee table carries several small vessels and stacked objects; its rectangular form anchors a pale patterned rug. A round woven stool sits close to the lower left, while another narrow cylindrical stool stands near the right foreground. Across the back of the room, two compact chairs face inward near a second group of windows. Long patterned curtains frame the brighter rear glass, and a vase of green branches catches daylight beyond the seating. A pale ceramic lamp on a side table glows beside the sofa, throwing a soft pool of warm light across upholstery and wood. The dark walls and ceiling absorb much of the light, but cool outdoor daylight from the windows picks out the chair edges, rug and tabletop. The materials remain distinct: woven fiber, matte fabric, polished dark wood, ceramics and lightly reflective glass. No people or readable text are present. The overall composition is deep and settled, balancing a central low table with repeated seating shapes and small amber points within the charcoal room.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形室内照片呈现情绪浓郁的起居室，炭黑护墙板、深色格栅天花和层叠灰色座椅构成空间。左墙旁，一张长浅灰沙发摆着奶油白、黑与赭色花纹靠垫。其上方，大雕花镜映出一盏小暖灯，为墙面再添一处琥珀色光。高格窗立在沙发后，棕褐色编织卷帘降下一部分。中央前景，一张低矮深木咖啡桌放着几个小器皿与叠放物件；它的矩形体量固定浅色花纹地毯。圆编织矮凳靠近左下，另一只细圆柱矮凳立在右侧前景。房间后方，两把紧凑扶手椅在另一组窗旁朝内相对。长花纹窗帘围住更明亮的后窗，一瓶绿枝在座椅后接住日光。沙发旁边桌上的浅色陶瓷灯发光，让软垫与木材上出现柔暖光池。暗墙与天花吸收大部分光，但窗外的冷日光仍勾出椅边、地毯和桌面。材料各自清楚：编织纤维、哑光布料、抛光深木、陶器与略带反光的玻璃。画面无人，也没有可读文字。整体构图纵深稳重，以居中的低桌平衡重复座椅形状和炭黑房间里的少量琥珀亮点。
style_prompt_en: A moody interior-photography treatment balances a charcoal and slate-gray envelope with cream woven textures and sparse amber illumination. Most of the frame stays in low-key shadow, yet directional daylight from the rear reveals layered edges and material grain without flattening them. Warm practical light creates small localized pools and reflections, providing rhythm across the darker field. Matte textiles, tightly woven surfaces, polished dark planes and ceramic highlights remain visibly different. Broad rectangles establish an orderly structure while rounded low forms interrupt it at varied depths. Patterns stay restrained and tactile, and the tonal progression from bright rear opening to shaded foreground gives the composition depth and quiet intimacy.
style_prompt_zh: 情绪浓郁的室内摄影处理用炭黑与板岩灰色包围空间，再以奶油白编织肌理和稀疏琥珀光取得平衡。画面大部留在低调阴影中，但后方定向日光显出层叠边缘和材料纹理，没有把它们照平。暖色实用光源形成少量局部光池与反射，为较暗色域提供节奏。哑光织物、紧密编织表面、抛光深色平面和陶瓷高光依然明显有别。宽阔矩形建立有序结构，低矮圆形体量在不同纵深处打断它。纹样克制而可触，明亮后方开口向阴影前景推进的调性过渡赋予构图纵深与安静亲密感。
theme_en: A moody gray sitting room layered with textured seating, dark wood and warm lamps
theme_zh: 灰色起居室以质感座椅、深木家具和暖灯层层铺陈
name: Thom Filicia
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
